name: rosetta-determine-if-two-triangles-overlap
code:
use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math
use System.StringSplitOptions

struct P(x: double, y: double) is
    -(o: P) -> P => P(x - o.x, y - o.y)
    ⋅(o: P) -> double => x * o.x + y * o.y
    normal: P => P(-y, x)
    show: string => "({x}, {y})"
si

use Triangle = P[]

shadow(t: Triangle, axis: P) -> (low: double, high: double) =>
    let lengths = t |> map(p => p ⋅ axis) |> collect_list() in
    (
        low = lengths |> reduce(lengths[0], Math.min),
        high = lengths |> reduce(lengths[0], Math.max))

separated(a: Triangle, b: Triangle, axis: P, touching: bool) -> bool =>
    let s = shadow(a, axis), t = shadow(b, axis) in
    if touching then s.high < t.low \/ t.high < s.low
    else s.high <= t.low \/ t.high <= s.low
    fi

edge_normals(t: Triangle) -> Pipe[P] =>
    (0..3) |> map(i => (t[(i + 1) % 3] - t[i]).normal)

overlap(a: Triangle, b: Triangle, touching: bool) -> bool =>
    let axes = edge_normals(a) |> cat(edge_normals(b)) in
    !(axes |> any(axis => separated(a, b, axis, touching)))

triangle(text: string) -> Triangle is
    let numbers =
        text.split(['(', ')', ','], StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)
            |> map(double.parse)
            |> collect_list()

    (0..3)
        |> map(i => P(numbers[2 * i], numbers[2 * i + 1]))
        |> collect_array()
si

let pairs = [
    ("(0,0),(5,0),(0,5)", "(0,0),(5,0),(0,6)"),
    ("(0,0),(0,5),(5,0)", "(0,0),(0,5),(5,0)"),
    ("(0,0),(5,0),(0,5)", "(-10,0),(-5,0),(-1,6)"),
    ("(0,0),(5,0),(2.5,5)", "(0,4),(2.5,-1),(5,4)"),
    ("(0,0),(1,1),(0,2)", "(2,1),(3,0),(3,2)"),
    ("(0,0),(1,1),(0,2)", "(2,1),(3,-2),(3,4)"),
    ("(0,0),(1,0),(0,1)", "(1,0),(2,0),(1,1)")
]
    |> map(((a, b)) => (triangle(a), triangle(b)))
    |> collect_list()

show(t: Triangle) -> string => t |> map(p => p.show) |> join(",")

for (a, b) in pairs do
    let verdict = if overlap(a, b, true) then "overlap" else "no overlap" fi

    write_line("{show(a)} and {show(b)}: {verdict}")
od

let (a, b) = pairs[pairs.count - 1]

write_line("")
write_line("the last pair touch at a corner")
write_line("overlapping if touching counts: {overlap(a, b, true)}")
write_line("overlapping if it does not: {overlap(a, b, false)}")

let panel = 120
let image = IMAGE(panel * 4, panel * 2)

image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)

for (i, (a, b)) in pairs |> index() do
    let left = cast double(i % 4 * panel), top = cast double(i / 4 * panel)
    let all = a |> cat(b) |> collect_list()
    let low_x = all |> map(p => p.x) |> reduce(all[0].x, Math.min)
    let high_x = all |> map(p => p.x) |> reduce(all[0].x, Math.max)
    let low_y = all |> map(p => p.y) |> reduce(all[0].y, Math.min)
    let high_y = all |> map(p => p.y) |> reduce(all[0].y, Math.max)
    let scale = 90.0D / Math.max(high_x - low_x, high_y - low_y)

    let place = (p: P) =>
        (
            x = left + 15.0D + (p.x - low_x) * scale,
            y = top + 105.0D - (p.y - low_y) * scale)

    let first = (a, 60ub, 110ub, 200ub), second = (b, 200ub, 90ub, 40ub)

    for (shape, r, g, blue) in [first, second] do
        image.colour(r, g, blue)
        image.stroke(2.0D)
        image.line(shape |> cat([shape[0]]) |> map(place) |> collect_list())
    od
od

image.write("triangles.png")

image.show("triangles.png")
